Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "When a complex solid is separated into smaller rectangular prisms, the sum of their volumes equals the total volume" ~~TRUE | FALSE~~
Solution: Separate the solid without losing material and count every non-overlapping part once. The sum of those part volumes equals the original total, so TRUE.

Question Choices: One layer of the solid contains 12 unit cubes. There are 3 identical layers. The total volume is __ cubic units.
Hints: Multiply layers by blocks per layer, then by the volume of each block.
Solution: 3 layers × 12 cubes per layer = 36 cubes. Each has volume 1 cubic units, so total volume = 36 × 1 = 36 cubic units.

Question Choices: A storage box is measured as 12 cm height, 5 cm width and 10 cm length. The volume of the storage box is __ cubic centimeters (cm³)
Hints: Multiply length, width and height, using the same length unit.
Solution: Base area = 10 × 5 = 50 square centimeters. Volume = base area × height = 50 × 12 = 600 cubic centimeters.

Question Choices: An irregular solid can be split into two parts, a larger rectangular prism and a smaller rectangular prism. The volume of the larger one is 150 cubic centimeter (cm³). The smaller one is 65 cubic centimeter (cm³). What is the volume of this solid in cubic centimeter (cm³)?
Hints: Add the volumes of all non-overlapping parts, counting each part once.
Solution: The parts do not overlap, so add each volume once: 150 + 65 = 215 cubic centimeters. Splitting changes the grouping, not the total amount of space.

Question Choices: Fill: A garden pond is 10 ft long, 8 ft wide, and 4 ft deep. A decorative stone block at the bottom measures 3 ft long, 2 ft wide, and 2 ft high. The pond is filled completely with water. How many cubic feet of water does the pond hold?
Hints: Find the whole container volume and subtract the volume occupied by the solid.
Solution: Whole capacity = 10 × 8 × 4 = 320 cubic feet. Occupied solid volume = 3 × 2 × 2 = 12 cubic feet. Remaining space = 320 − 12 = 308 cubic feet. Check: 308 + 12 = 320.
